title: Era summary
summary: Summarise exposure courses for one declared drug class. Courses merge nearby fills using the stated gap and persistence; recorded covered days union actual recorded intervals and exclude those extensions. Coverage here is not restricted to observed days. Missing recorded ends use valid days supply, then the language's point-record policy.

required_tables.conditional: Tables, value/unit/time roles and vocabulary required by the supplied index and other event bindings.

required_roles.index: person, event key, start; interval end according to index policy

limitations: See documentation for fixed policies, windows, missingness, coverage, tie order, output schema and analysis limitations.
